lines.text: おや、見ない顔だ。ここは学生寮だよ。授業はもう始まっているんじゃないのかい。
lines.text_en: Well now, a face I don't know. This is the student dormitory. Shouldn't your class have started by now?

lines.speaker: 自分
lines.text_en: ...I just wanted to rest. Only for a little while.

lines.text: 布団はそこだ。ただし言っておくが、この時間に横になったら今日はもう終わりだぞ。
lines.text_en: The futon is over there. But I'll say this plainly: lie down at this hour and your day is finished.

lines.text: それでもいいなら、もう一度わたしに声を掛けなさい。
lines.text_en: If that is still what you want, come and speak to me once more.

lines.text: そうか。毛布は畳んで返しておきなさい。
lines.text_en: So be it. Fold the blanket and put it back when you're done.

lines.text: なに、一日くらいどうということはない。誰にも言わんよ。
lines.text_en: Never mind. One day is nothing at all. I won't tell a soul.

lines.text: 門限は 23 時だ。それだけ守ってくれれば、わたしは何も言わん。
lines.text_en: Curfew is eleven at night. Keep to that and you'll hear nothing from me.
